clips.title: The story
paras: Bears claim Grizzlepaw Ridge, the rough hills south of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. Ol' Sooty prowls among them, feared by local hunters.

Grizzlepaw Ridge rises above the road south of Thelsamar, with Stonesplinter Valley along its western edge. Territorial bears claim the rough slopes and threaten travelers who skirt the mountains. Deep within the ridge lives Ol' Sooty, a massive, unusually fierce bear feared by local hunters. Travelers between the dwarven settlements watch the tree line and rocky terraces above.
